validity.recommendation: Keep the row (real, operating gas trunk). Add OtherEnglishNames = 'Sarakhs-Neka Gas Pipeline' (the common/official name); the western terminus is more accurately Neka (official) with the corridor continuing to Sari/Rasht. Correct the operator to National Iranian Gas Company / Region 4 Gas Transmission Operations (NIOC in GulfPub is wrong for a domestic gas transmission line); owner 'Iran Ministry of Petroleum' is fine. Flag Capacity=12 bcm/y as unverified.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: CONFIRMED by two independent sources that both name the line and match GEM's specs. Oil & Gas Journal describes 'the 800 km, 30 and 36 in. Sarakhs-Neka pipeline' (existing, with a 380 km 30-in Rasht-Neka line then under construction) — matches GEM's 795 km / 30,36 in almost exactly. Shana (Iran oil-ministry agency, independent of GEM) reports a corridor-reclassification on the in-service 'خط انتقال گاز سرخس نکا' (Sarakhs-Neka gas transmission line): 30 in, operated by Region 4 Gas Transmission Operations, running through Razavi Khorasan, North Khorasan, Golestan, Mazandaran and Semnan provinces, passing near Mashhad. The gem.wiki row's own two citations are weak (Enipedia archive = GEM-adjacent wiki; a WikiLeaks Turkmen-gas-price cable that does not name this pipeline) — but independent corroboration is solid, so existence is not in doubt. CLASSIFICATION: CONFIRMED as a gas transmission trunk (major 30/36-in line feeding northern/Caspian provinces), not gathering/process/oil. DUPLICATE: NOT an internal GEM duplicate — no other roster PID represents the Sarakhs–Neka(–Rasht) trunk (P0742 Dauletabad-Sarakhs-Khangiran is the distinct upstream Turkmen-import feed into the Sarakhs/Khangiran hub; P5984 Rasht-Chelavend is the separate Rasht→Azerbaijan line). It maps 1:1 to GulfPub 'Sarakhs - Mashad - Neka - Rasht' (operating, 36 in, 735 km, Sarakhs→Rasht) — same physical trunk, so GulfPub is corroboration, not a second GEM entity. ATTRIBUTION caveat: operator should be NIGC / Region 4 Gas Transmission Operations (per Shana), not NIOC (GulfPub). NAME caveat: 'Sarakhs-Sari' is nonstandard; OGJ/Shana call it Sarakhs-Neka, GulfPub extends to Rasht. SPEC: length 795 km corroborated (OGJ 800 km; GulfPub 735 km — minor variance); diameter 30,36 corroborated (OGJ '30 and 36 in'; Shana 30 in). Capacity 12 bcm/y NOT independently corroborated (weak field; no source found agreeing on the figure).

fills.researcher_notes: OGJ treats the Sarakhs-Neka line as existing (in service) while the Rasht-Neka extension is 'under construction'; Shana reports a corridor reclassification on the in-service line — both support status=operating.
Both sources describe a gas transmission line (Shana: 'خط انتقال گاز'; OGJ: gas pipeline).
OGJ gives '800 km' for the Sarakhs-Neka pipeline (GEM 795 km; GulfPub 735 km) — corroborates the ~795-800 km magnitude; single strong source, so medium.
OGJ: '30 and 36 in.' Sarakhs-Neka pipeline (matches GEM '30, 36'). Shana confirms 30 in on the reclassified section. GulfPub 36 in. Corroborated.

Start=Sarakhs confirmed by both. Western terminus: OGJ/Shana name Neka (official terminus) not Sari; Sari is ~30 km west of Neka on the same corridor, and GulfPub extends the trunk to Rasht. Endpoint 'Sari' is defensible but the standard endpoint is Neka — recommend recording OtherEnglishNames/EndLocation review. Medium because of the Neka-vs-Sari terminus ambiguity.

No independent source found stating a 12 bcm/y throughput for the Sarakhs-Neka line. OGJ/Shana give length+diameter but not annual capacity; GulfPub Capacity_mmcfd is a 300 placeholder (not real). Leaving the value in place but UNRESOLVED — do not treat 12 bcm/y as verified.

routes.corridor_desc: From Sarakhs on the Turkmenistan border (NE Iran, Razavi Khorasan), the line runs southwest to the Mashhad area, then turns west/northwest across North Khorasan into Golestan, then follows the Caspian littoral / northern Alborz foothills westward through Mazandaran (Golestan→Behshahr→Neka→Sari). Province chain (Razavi Khorasan, North Khorasan, Golestan, Mazandaran, Semnan) is sourced from Shana; the GulfPub counterpart 'Sarakhs-Mashad-Neka-Rasht' extends the same corridor west to Rasht (Gilan). Endpoint city coordinates are well-known and defensible; the exact pipeline alignment between them is not derived from a route file, so the corridor is a defensible band rather than a surveyed centerline.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints and province chain established from Shana (Sarakhs-Neka line through Razavi Khorasan/North Khorasan/Golestan/Mazandaran/Semnan, near Mashhad) and OGJ (Sarakhs-Neka, 800 km). All coordinates are for named, real cities (Sarakhs, Mashhad, Neka, Sari) — none fabricated. Note the GEM endpoint 'Sari' vs the official terminus 'Neka'; retaining high accuracy for the endpoint/corridor but flagging the terminus-name discrepancy. The current RouteNotes value is a Wikimedia infrastructure-map image, not a usable route source.

summary: P1639 Sarakhs-Sari (=official Sarakhs-Neka) gas trunk is REAL and correctly classed; confirmed (caveat): operator should be NIGC/Region 4 not NIOC, name/terminus is Sarakhs-Neka not -Sari, capacity 12 bcm/y unverified.
